mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_approval_escalation (escalation_id, experiment_id, approval_type, draft_version, app_id, owner, experiment_name, approval_submitted_at, approval_elapsed_hours, approval_sla_hours, approval_sla_status, escalation_owners, escalation_reason, notification_channel, notification_payload_json, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, escalation_status) VALUES (#{entity.escalationId}, #{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.approvalType}, #{entity.draftVersion}, #{entity.appId}, #{entity.owner}, #{entity.experimentName}, #{entity.approvalSubmittedAt}, #{entity.approvalElapsedHours}, #{entity.approvalSlaHours}, #{entity.approvalSlaStatus}, #{entity.escalationOwners}, #{entity.escalationReason}, #{entity.notificationChannel}, #{entity.notificationPayloadJson}, #{entity.notificationStatus}, #{entity.notificationAttemptCount}, #{entity.escalationStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE approval_elapsed_hours = VALUES(approval_elapsed_hours), approval_sla_status = VALUES(approval_sla_status), escalation_reason = VALUES(escalation_reason), notification_payload_json = VALUES(notification_payload_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, escalation_id, experiment_id, approval_type, draft_version, app_id, owner, experiment_name, approval_submitted_at, approval_elapsed_hours, approval_sla_hours, approval_sla_status, escalation_owners, escalation_reason, notification_channel, notification_payload_json, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, notification_last_attempt_at, notification_next_attempt_at, notification_delivered_at, notification_last_error, escalation_status, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_comment, acknowledged_at, resolved_by, resolved_reason, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId}

SELECT id, escalation_id, experiment_id, approval_type, draft_version, app_id, owner, experiment_name, approval_submitted_at, approval_elapsed_hours, approval_sla_hours, approval_sla_status, escalation_owners, escalation_reason, notification_channel, notification_payload_json, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, notification_last_attempt_at, notification_next_attempt_at, notification_delivered_at, notification_last_error, escalation_status, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_comment, acknowledged_at, resolved_by, resolved_reason, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation WHERE (#{appId} IS NULL OR app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR owner = #{owner}) AND (#{escalationStatus} IS NULL OR escalation_status = #{escalationStatus}) ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, escalation_id, experiment_id, approval_type, draft_version, app_id, owner, experiment_name, approval_submitted_at, approval_elapsed_hours, approval_sla_hours, approval_sla_status, escalation_owners, escalation_reason, notification_channel, notification_payload_json, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, notification_last_attempt_at, notification_next_attempt_at, notification_delivered_at, notification_last_error, escalation_status, acknowledged_by, acknowledged_comment, acknowledged_at, resolved_by, resolved_reason, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation WHERE escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND ( notification_status = 'PENDING' OR (notification_status = 'RETRY' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (notification_status = 'DISPATCHING' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery (escalation_id, channel_name, target_key, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, active) VALUES
(#{entity.escalationId}, #{entity.channelName}, #{entity.targetKey}, #{entity.notificationStatus}, #{entity.notificationAttemptCount}, 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_name = VALUES(channel_name), active = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, escalation_id, channel_name, target_key, notification_status, notification_attempt_count, notification_last_attempt_at, notification_next_attempt_at, notification_delivered_at, notification_last_error, active, created_at, updated_at FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND active = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT escalation_status AS status, COUNT(1) AS escalation_count FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation WHERE (#{appId} IS NULL OR app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR owner = #{owner}) GROUP BY escalation_status

SELECT notification_status AS status, COUNT(1) AS escalation_count FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation WHERE (#{appId} IS NULL OR app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR owner = #{owner}) AND escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') GROUP BY notification_status

SELECT delivery.notification_status AS status, COUNT(1) AS escalation_count FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery INNER JOIN pisces_experiment_approval_escalation escalation ON escalation.escalation_id = delivery.escalation_id WHERE delivery.active = 1 AND escalation.escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND (#{appId} IS NULL OR escalation.app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR escalation.owner = #{owner}) GROUP BY delivery.notification_status
mapper.update: UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET escalation_status = 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledged_by = #{operator}, acknowledged_comment = #{comment}, acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND escalation_status = 'OPEN'

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'DISPATCHING', notification_last_attempt_at = #{now}, notification_next_attempt_at = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND ( notification_status = 'PENDING' OR (notification_status = 'RETRY' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (notification_status = 'DISPATCHING' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) )

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'SENT', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{deliveredAt}, notification_delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = NULL, notification_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId}

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'RETRY', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, notification_last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId}

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'DEAD', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = NULL, notification_last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId}

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery SET notification_status = 'DISPATCHING', notification_last_attempt_at = #{now}, notification_next_attempt_at = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND active = 1 AND ( notification_status = 'PENDING' OR (notification_status = 'RETRY' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (notification_status = 'DISPATCHING' AND notification_next_attempt_at <= #{now}) )

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery SET notification_status = 'SENT', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{deliveredAt}, notification_delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = NULL, notification_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND active = 1

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery SET notification_status = 'RETRY', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, notification_last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND active = 1

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery SET notification_status = 'DEAD', notification_attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, notification_last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, notification_next_attempt_at = NULL, notification_last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND target_key = #{targetKey} AND active = 1

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation escalation SET notification_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status = 'DEAD' ) THEN 'DEAD' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status = 'RETRY' ) THEN 'RETRY' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status = 'DISPATCHING' ) THEN 'DISPATCHING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status = 'PENDING' ) THEN 'PENDING' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 ) THEN 'SENT' ELSE escalation.notification_status END, notification_attempt_count = COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(delivery.notification_attempt_count) FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 ), escalation.notification_attempt_count), notification_last_attempt_at = ( SELECT MAX(delivery.notification_last_attempt_at) FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 ), notification_next_attempt_at = ( SELECT MIN(delivery.notification_next_attempt_at) FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status IN ('RETRY', 'DISPATCHING') ), notification_delivered_at = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status != 'SENT' ) THEN ( SELECT MAX(delivery.notification_delivered_at) FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery WHERE delivery.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery.active = 1 ) ELSE NULL END, notification_last_error = ( SELECT delivery_error.notification_last_error FROM pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery_error WHERE delivery_error.escalation_id = escalation.escalation_id AND delivery_error.active = 1 AND delivery_error.notification_last_error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY delivery_error.updated_at DESC, delivery_error.id DESC LIMIT 1 ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation.escalation_id = #{escalationId}

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'RETRY', notification_attempt_count = 0, notification_last_attempt_at = NULL, notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, notification_delivered_at = NULL, notification_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND notification_status = 'DEAD'

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery SET notification_status = 'RETRY', notification_attempt_count = 0, notification_last_attempt_at = NULL, notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, notification_delivered_at = NULL, notification_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_id = #{escalationId} AND active = 1 AND notification_status = 'DEAD'

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation SET notification_status = 'RETRY', notification_attempt_count = 0, notification_last_attempt_at = NULL, notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, notification_delivered_at = NULL, notification_last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND notification_status = 'DEAD' AND (#{appId} IS NULL OR app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR owner = #{owner})

UPDATE pisces_experiment_approval_escalation_delivery delivery INNER JOIN pisces_experiment_approval_escalation escalation ON escalation.escalation_id = delivery.escalation_id SET delivery.notification_status = 'RETRY', delivery.notification_attempt_count = 0, delivery.notification_last_attempt_at = NULL, delivery.notification_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, delivery.notification_delivered_at = NULL, delivery.notification_last_error = NULL, delivery.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery.active = 1 AND delivery.notification_status = 'DEAD' AND escalation.escalation_status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED') AND escalation.notification_status = 'DEAD' AND (#{appId} IS NULL OR escalation.app_id = #{appId}) AND (#{owner} IS NULL OR escalation.owner = #{owner})
